sentences.text: Sarajit Bagdi vs Unknown on 13 September, 2024

In re: An application for bail under Section 439 of the C  Procedure/483 of BNSS in connection with Kandi Pol  Case No. 116 of 2024 dated 20.02.2024 under Sectio  498A/326/307/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with  3/4 of the D.P. Act.
 -And-  In the matter of : Sarajit Bagdi  
 Md. Fahiz Ali,
 ... Fo  Mr. Sudip Kumar,
 Mr. Sujata Das,
 ..
 1.
Heard the learned lawyers for both the parties.
2. Petitioner is in custody for eight months.
He submits he has been falsely implicated.
3. Learned Advocate for the State opposes the bail prayer.
4. We have considered the materials on record.
The incident occurred two years after marriage.
While the neighbours state that the victim confided that she had set herself on fire.
Hospital records note it is a case of accidental burns.

5. In view of the aforesaid dichotomous position and period of detention suffered by the petitioner,
we are inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

6. Accordingly, we direct that the petitioner, namely, Sarajit Bagdi, shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs. 10,000/-, with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the Learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kandi, Murshidabad and on further conditions that the Signed By :
ABHIJIT KOLE High Court of Calcutta 19 th of September 2024 04:12:05 PM petitioner shall appear before the trial Court on every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate the witnesses and/or tamper with evidence in any Sarajit Bagdi vs Unknown on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7313188/
1 manner whatsoever.
7.
